summary: Aqueous-filled space behind the cornea; optically empty when healthy. Its depth sets the gap between the corneal and iris beams.

depth.note: Central depth from corneal endothelium to anterior lens; shallows as the lens thickens.

cells_grade.note: SUN Working Group cell grade (0 to 4+), 1x1 mm beam.

measured_by: Van Herick estimate at the limbus

provenance.source: Depth: Atchison & Smith (2000); grading: SUN Working Group, Am J Ophthalmol 140:509 (2005)
